sections.title: Package definition and commands
sections.what: Names the package, defines the hello and typecheck commands, and lists its tools and libraries.
sections.why: pnpm needs this file to install the scripts folder's dependencies and to run its tasks.
sections.watch_out: Moving bcryptjs or pg to development-only dependencies would break the local setup scripts when they run.

summary: Package file for the scripts folder. It names the package, defines a hello command and a typecheck command, and lists the tools and database libraries the scripts need.
purpose: Tells pnpm how to run tasks in the scripts folder and which libraries to install for them.
why: Likely reason: each folder in a workspace has its own package file so its dependencies stay separate. The code does not state this directly.
how: Declares the package as private and as an ES module. Defines two commands. Lists build-time type helpers and tools, plus two runtime libraries.
inputs: None directly. pnpm reads this file.
outputs: Installed packages and two runnable commands, hello and typecheck.
risks: Versions are caret ranges, which allow newer minor updates. Several entries use catalog references, so they depend on the root workspace catalog.
debug: If install fails, check the catalog entries for tsx and @types/node in the root workspace. If hello fails, check that src/hello.ts exists.
